explanation: Eta (ep->ep eta) scan requested at W=1.700 GeV (above eta threshold 1.485 GeV), Q2=1.500 GeV2, phi*=90 deg, cos theta* from -1 to +1 in 5 steps (-1.0, -0.5, 0.0, 0.5, 1.0). Produced a single EXCLURAD input file (N=5 <=10 limit) with eta configuration: model=3 (EtaMAID-2023), ivec=1 (recoil proton), bmom=6.535 GeV, vcut=0.166 GeV2, full O(alpha) mode. The extreme cos theta* = +/-1 points sit at the t-max/min edges of the two-body phase space at this W; the code may throw a NAG integration error (ifail=2) or return unphysical values there, which is why the repository includes a skip-unphys runner. No physical impossibility—scan is kinematically allowed—but users should expect possible integration warnings at the endpoints and may need to exclude +/-1 if results fail. Legacy '0error...' termination line preserved per parser requirement.
